title: VGGish Embeddings
text: 提取 VGGish 嵌入，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；{Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} 指定输入信号的采样率{Overlap percentage (%)} 指定连续 mel 频谱图之间的重叠百分比，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 嵌入 row vector of length 128

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: 输入信号的采样率（Hz） 16e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Overlap percentage (%)
params.values: 连续 mel 频谱图之间的重叠百分比 50 (default) | [0 100)
